title: test_asym: add ecdh-p384 HKDF-SHA384 known-answer test
description: Add a test case in tests/userspace/test_asym.c (or tests/kernel/test_kpp.c) that verifies ecdh-p384 agree() produces the expected HKDF-SHA384 OKM against the known-answer vector in ecdh_p384.h. Mirror the existing ecdh-p256 HKDF-SHA256 test structure.
